faq.question: What does Juma mean?
faq.answer: Juma is associated with the Arabic form جُمْعَة, whose core sense is juma; born on friday (swahili form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Juma?
faq.answer: Juma is associated with Arabic. Juma is the Swahili form of Arabic جُمْعَة (Jumʿa, 'Friday'), used for a child born on Friday.

faq.question: Is Juma an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form جُمْعَة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Juma an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Juma can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Juma a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Juma should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Jumʿa is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.question: What does Juma mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Juma is rendered جمعه and carries the sense جمعه، زاده جمعه.
